title: Installed Wright: common and saved process interfaces
summary: Genuine local wheel installation, cached dependencies, copied isolated engineering workspace; no model/compiler or engineering dispatch.

manualSteps.label: Open installed Wright
manualSteps.instruction: Open the installed native Wright home page, then the isolated proof workspace.

manualSteps.label: Open process
manualSteps.instruction: Click Workflows, Workflow files, Open workflow, then choose the saved wheel workflow.

manualSteps.label: Use working view
manualSteps.instruction: Click Use saved process and open the second recorded run link.

manualSteps.label: Reuse interface
manualSteps.instruction: Click Create or choose interface, choose the saved focus-wheel interface and current revision, then Open saved interface.

manualSteps.label: Reload
manualSteps.instruction: Reload the working tab and inspect the same waiting review. Leave the review unanswered.

steps.label: Installed workspace loads
steps.action: Open native home and proof workspace.
steps.expected: Native session bootstrap and workspace entry.
steps.actual: Installed frontend loads with native HttpOnly session and Workflows control.
steps.summary: Installed frontend loads with native HttpOnly session and Workflows control.

steps.label: Established editor entry
steps.actual: Workflow file menu and editor open within the installed workspace.
steps.summary: Workflow file menu and editor open within the installed workspace.

steps.label: Saved engineering workflow
steps.action: Click Workflow files, then Open workflow.
steps.actual: Accepted wheel workflow appears in the installed file chooser.
steps.summary: Accepted wheel workflow appears in the installed file chooser.

steps.label: Authoring and working views share source
steps.expected: Same accepted source in diagram and working view.
steps.actual: The original review/repair/slice source is open with Use saved process enabled.
steps.purpose: Authoring and working views share source
steps.summary: The original review/repair/slice source is open with Use saved process enabled.

steps.label: Installed common working view
steps.expected: Common view opens as a workspace tab.
steps.actual: Installed shared common view opens without starting another run.
steps.summary: Installed shared common view opens without starting another run.

steps.label: Exact existing run remains waiting
steps.expected: Existing second run remains at its declared review.
steps.actual: Common view shows the same second run and pending geometry-basis review.
steps.summary: Common view shows the same second run and pending geometry-basis review.

steps.label: Saved UI independent of authoring compiler
steps.expected: Unavailable compiler explained; saved interfaces offered.
steps.actual: Compiler unavailable is explicit and the saved interface chooser remains usable.
steps.purpose: Saved UI independent of authoring compiler
steps.summary: Compiler unavailable is explicit and the saved interface chooser remains usable.

steps.label: Existing built revision selected
steps.action: Choose saved focus-wheel interface and current revision.
steps.actual: Exact original saved UI/revision selected without generating or compiling.
steps.summary: Exact original saved UI/revision selected without generating or compiling.

steps.label: Installed saved interface mounts
steps.expected: Saved React UI connected to the exact run through the installed bridge.
steps.actual: Saved UI renders in its workspace tab with the second run’s single result and waiting review.
steps.summary: Saved UI renders in its workspace tab with the second run’s single result and waiting review.

steps.label: Installed reopening reconciles
steps.expected: Same run, saved revision and waiting review after reload.
steps.actual: Installed tab restores the same waiting run and saved compiled interface.
steps.summary: Installed tab restores the same waiting run and saved compiled interface.
